title: Situation Room daily static root-cause and durable recovery
objective: Reproduce the current Situation Room Daily Static Discovery failure on fresh main, determine why the first natural scheduled production run was cancelled, and implement the smallest deterministic repair that restores a durable discovery artifact without weakening the catalyst firewall, fabricating event timestamps, converting retrieval failure into NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST, or granting canonical market authority.

origin.thread_label: 2026-08-28 daily evidence and catalyst health watch

evidence.summary: Situation Room Daily Static Discovery scheduled run on 2026-08-27 completed as cancelled and is the current LATEST_RUN_FAILED blocker.
Fresh health generated 2026-08-28T00:28:29.822625Z classifies situation-room-daily-static.yml as RED with LATEST_RUN_FAILED.
Owner live gate is recovering after prior failures and must remain an independent contract check rather than being bypassed.
Situation Room remains discovery-only, shadow/context-only and cannot alter canonical market state, thresholds, scores or portfolio actions.

reproduction: On fresh main, inspect run 33099422005, its jobs and logs, then execute the same production-shaped workflow path using the current static daily adapter. Identify whether cancellation came from concurrency, main-writer contention, workflow orchestration, adapter exit semantics, network/retrieval handling or another bounded cause. Do not assume the prior entrypoint defect is still causal. Stop as clean no-op if a later natural run has already succeeded and the failure cannot be reproduced.

positive: A production-shaped run completes without cancellation and persists one explicit Situation Room discovery state when the daily briefing is reachable.
Reachable but metadata-incomplete briefing yields explicit REVIEW_REQUIRED or equivalent bounded discovery state rather than false NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST.
Primary-source or high-quality corroboration remains downstream of discovery and is not bypassed.
The workflow remains discovery-only with canonical_effect=false, market_state_effect=false and portfolio_effect=false.
negative: Network or source failure cannot be reported as NO_NEW_MATERIAL_CATALYST.
URL date cannot be promoted to a fabricated precise event_time_utc.
The repair cannot weaken catalyst firewall semantics or grant execution/portfolio authority.
A cancellation caused solely by global writer contention must be handled without parallel competing main writers or destructive concurrency changes.

clean_noop_condition: A fresh natural scheduled Situation Room run already succeeds, writes the expected durable discovery state, and the current health finding clears without further code changes.
stop_condition: Stop without implementation if fresh reproduction fails, the issue is only stale health state, or the required repair exceeds allowed_change_scope or would weaken catalyst governance.
escalation_condition: Escalate to FRAMEWORK_OWNER if resolution requires canonical market semantics, new external authority, paid provider access, portfolio logic, or a change to the catalyst firewall.
rollback_plan: Revert only the bounded Situation Room workflow/adapter/test changes. Do not rewrite previously captured catalyst evidence.
